notes: Zero to six groups with states 0..3, finished and plain types, index words 0..4 or 0x100, member counts 0..6 (array pointer 0 in a few), member states 0/1/2/9; 0, 1, 4, 8, 12 or -1 update records of kinds 0..3 addressed to existing or absent groups and members. 0xb3fb0 runs as original code; the other callees are logging stubs, drawing 0xcb984 results and 0xcc6c0 buffers from their own queues.
